prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / 2D game background.
Produce ONLY a painted background plate for a cozy fantasy travel game, landscape 16:9, ideally 1920 x 1080. It will sit BEHIND a large brass compass on the LEFT and an open caramel leather suitcase on the RIGHT. Do NOT draw those objects or any UI.
Scene: an inviting travel preparation table, seen from a gently elevated three-quarter overhead camera, with the tabletop filling the entire frame, NO horizon, room, wall or furniture edges. Pale weathered ash wood, warm ivory and soft sandy beige tones, subtle wide horizontal planks and delicate painted grain. A large old folded travel map partly unrolled diagonally from the lower-left edge, only its faint coastlines and a few folds visible near the outer edges; faded muted blue-gray ink, no readable words, no compass rose. A tiny wooden pencil and a curl of cream paper at the far upper-right edge. A few cropped cream travel papers at the far lower-right edge. These are peripheral quiet atmospheric details, not interactive items.
Composition is CRITICAL: keep the ENTIRE CENTER from x=10% to x=90%, y=12% to y=83% almost empty and visually calm, reserved for the two big game objects. The central TOP 12% and central BOTTOM 15% must be especially pale, uniform and low detail for dark brown UI labels. Decorations must stay at the extreme edges and corners, mostly cropped out. Soft warm daylight from upper left, very subtle diagonal light, no hard shadows or high contrast behind text. Beautiful tactility, simple gently irregular shapes and soft brush shading; hand-painted 2D children's travel adventure storybook art, not a photo, not glossy 3D, not pixel art. Harmonize with gold brass, caramel leather and cream parchment assets.
Avoid: dominant green, teal or dark background; saturated orange wood; busy map lines in center; heavy vignette; frame or border; lettering, labels or numbers; buttons; compass; suitcase; figurines; characters; coins; floating particles; flowers; watermark. Full-bleed opaque environment background, not a mockup or a sprite sheet. It must breathe and make the colorful foreground objects easy to read.
